The model library browses and manages installed speech and language models with their declared capabilities, sizes, per-asset licenses and owning runtime (D-022). Identity is publisher name, revision string and a SHA-256 over the ordered weight file set, so two quantizations under one name are distinguishable and a result names exactly what produced it. Compatibility is checked before activation against the runtime descriptor covering runtime kind, version range, quantization, sample rate and context length, and user-supplied models take the same path with the same load smoke test, so an unreadable quantization fails at install instead of mid-dictation. The smoke test is a capability check and never a quality judgment: a compatible model with no benchmark row activates normally and is labeled unmeasured, and the evaluation harness described under verification is development tooling that gates nothing in the application. Installation stages, verifies, smoke-tests, then renames into an immutable content-addressed blob directory that is never written again, after which one transaction records the installation with its notices and moves the active pointer; a crash between those steps leaves an unreferenced blob that garbage collection removes, and a run pinned to the previous installation holds a lease so its weights survive activation. A failed download or import therefore cannot replace a working installation, and a failed user import stays in staging with its error attached. Model loading never triggers a download: runtimes receive absolute paths, initializers that can fetch are prohibited by a build check, acquisition is confined to an explicitly invoked downloader on a host allowlist, and inference services are denied the network by their sandbox (D-028, D-003). Replacing a runtime has bounded effect because runtimes are separate adapter targets and separate service binaries with their own descriptors and parameter schemas (D-002, D-020, D-021); common parameters render generically while runtime-specific ones may supply presentation hooks, and storage is attributable per runtime through the blob store, so removing a runtime releases its weights. Activation of a pairing exceeding the residency budget is refused with the arithmetic shown, labeled measured or declared, and overridable by the user (D-027).

A menu bar status item is the always-available surface showing state, effective mode, recent results and settings, complementing the recording panel (D-011, D-025). Microphone level adjustment is software gain on captured buffers by default, with metering and a clipping indicator, so the common case changes no system state and has nothing to restore; setting the input device's hardware volume is opt-in and is restored only if the current value still equals what the app set. Optional pausing of media playback checks whether the default output device is running, using a public CoreAudio property and no private framework, and posts a play-pause key when something is playing. Because that evidence identifies neither the application that reacted nor whether anything paused, resume is offered as a user action in the panel and menu for ten minutes instead of performed automatically; users who accept the uncertainty can enable automatic resume, which fires only when the app posted the pause, the same output device is still default, the device is still idle and under ten minutes have elapsed. Competing applications and manual user edits therefore produce no restoration and a note that playback or the setting was left as found, instead of the app overwriting a state someone else established. The macOS baseline and the public APIs these behaviors use are set by D-001, with anything newer behind an availability check and a defined fallback.

open_questions.question: Does the application ship outside the Mac App Store under Developer ID, as this design assumes? Text delivery and Recording controls both depend on it: a sandboxed App Store build cannot set selected text in another application's accessibility element and cannot run a session-level consuming event tap.
open_questions.resolution: Confirm the distribution channel with the product owner before the delivery and shortcut boundaries are built. There is no in-design fallback: the nearest available substitutes are a user-installed input method for insertion, which changes the user's typing setup and still requires their action, and system hotkeys without key-up, which cannot express push-to-talk at all. If App Store distribution is required, the Text delivery and Recording controls clauses need revision, since the features as specified are not implementable under that sandbox.

open_questions.question: Can a sandboxed XPC service with the network client entitlement withheld load the chosen model weights and run Core ML and Metal inference, and does a process it spawns inherit the restriction?
open_questions.resolution: Gate F2, before the entitlement set and the model-access path are frozen. Load a model inside the service, attempt outbound connections and a write outside the job scratch directory and assert both fail, then repeat from a spawned child. This was blocking while no isolation mechanism had been selected; RESEARCH's follow-up names signed services with entitlements withheld, so the mechanism is chosen and what remains is verification. If the sandbox blocks model loading, the fallback is a read-only path exception for Models/blobs, and failing that an unsandboxed service with the offline claim narrowed to structural absence plus a network-denied session test, which still satisfies the requirement that data stays on the Mac while making the guarantee weaker.

open_questions.question: How does the shipping speech runtime behave on long input and under cancellation: peak resident size as a function of duration, cancellation latency, and whether a resumed checkpoint reproduces the unpreempted transcript?
open_questions.resolution: Gate F1, before the scheduler's preemption policy and the residency admission arithmetic are frozen. Measure the adapter on a fixed corpus at 30 seconds, 10 minutes, 1 hour and 3 hours on the target machine, recording word error rate by language, time to final transcript, service peak resident size, cancellation latency at p50 and p95, and transcript equivalence after resume. The runtime choice itself is made in D-020 on integration, licensing and dependency evidence; these are the measurements that evaluate it. If the memory slope cannot be bounded by windowing, the whisper.cpp adapter behind the same port is the fallback and satisfies the same requirement.

open_questions.question: How much captured audio is lost when the writer is killed at an arbitrary offset, and does the packet index survive a kill during its own fsync?
open_questions.resolution: Gate F3, before recovery expectations for the capturing and sealing states are approved. Kill the writer at randomized offsets across chunk boundaries and mid-fsync, recover, and record the maximum lost interval and any index corruption. The measured bound becomes the approved expectation in the recovery behavior table. If it exceeds one chunk period plus unflushed data, shorten the chunk period and re-measure, accepting more frequent fsyncs.

open_questions.question: Which insertion paths preserve existing field content and give an observable success signal in the target applications, and what pasteboard read delay does each target exhibit?
open_questions.resolution: Gate F4, before per-application delivery profiles ship. Prototype selected-text insertion and paste with readback in the applications listed under verification, recording for each whether existing content survives, whether a change is observable, and when the pasteboard is read. The ladder does not wait on the table, because its default for an unmeasured target is one unconfirmed attempt with deferred restore and a panel affordance to copy or deliver again, which satisfies the delivery requirement without it. The table removes avoidable holds and unsafe restores.

open_questions.question: Does the selected diarizer expose evidence that supports a defensible attribution threshold, and which of its weight assets may be offered for download rather than only imported?
open_questions.resolution: Evaluate on a labeled internal meeting set, reporting diarization error rate, the share of segments carrying unknown confidence, whether clustering distance is monotone with correctness, and behavior under speaker echo. Compile the notice inventory per asset in parallel. The runtime is chosen in D-023 and the feature ships either way: absent calibration is represented as unknown with manual assignment available, and an asset whose notice does not permit redistribution stays importable. A calibration result would let a derived threshold replace the unverified state, with its calibration curve recorded.

open_questions.question: Which languages get validator packs at ship, and how often does the fail-closed path deny rewriting to users who wanted it?
open_questions.resolution: Ship the English pack with the first generation modes and add packs driven by measured fallback rates per language. If the denial rate is high for a language with good recognition, that pack moves ahead of other language work; the per-mode override exists in the meantime and records itself on the result.

open_questions.question: Which browsers expose the current URL through accessibility, and which need automation permission or provide nothing?
open_questions.resolution: Enumerate per browser and record a dated table before URL rules ship. The rule engine treats an unreadable URL as a non-match, so an incomplete table degrades to bundle-identifier rules and the default mode.

open_questions.question: Is FTS5 compiled into the system SQLite on the chosen baseline?
open_questions.resolution: A runtime check during store setup. If absent, build GRDB against a bundled SQLite, accepting a larger binary and an update obligation, and record the change against D-005.

open_questions.question: Is an 8B-class instruct model at 4-bit quantization good enough for Email and Meeting notes on the 16 GB target, or does a smaller model with tighter prompts do better once the contract validator is applied?
open_questions.resolution: Score two or three sizes against the fidelity corpus using the human rubric, recording validator fallback rates per model. The result sets the recommended default pairing; model selection is per mode either way, so a wrong default is a settings change.

open_questions.question: Can the provisional live pass run alongside capture without dropping frames or degrading the final pass on the target machine?
open_questions.resolution: Measure alongside the runtime work: capture with and without the provisional pass, comparing dropped frame counts, final word error rate and time to final transcript. If the cost is material, the preview degrades to waveform plus a voice-activity indicator, which the panel already has a state for.
